scope: Follow-up public-data search for an independent synchronized station-to-vehicle fueling holdout

eligibility_rule.required_rights: explicit public reuse or written permission for derived metrics and journal publication

candidates.title: HRSs refueling perfromance Data sets
candidates.finding: The public description identifies modeling and simulation results plus input parameters and time-resolved simulated outputs. It is not an independent measured station or vehicle experiment.
candidates.reuse_status: Open metadata and CC BY record; excluded from physical external validation and cannot be used to claim field agreement.

candidates.title: European H2-Stations export API
candidates.finding: The API exposes station metadata, availability, events, usage, hydrogen storage and pricing signals. It does not expose a synchronized pressure-temperature-mass-flow trace for a vehicle-fueling event.
candidates.reuse_status: Open CC BY station-context data; not eligible for the numerical full-loop holdout.

candidates.title: California Hydrogen Refueling Stations – Lessons for Texas
candidates.finding: The repository record is a technical report about deployment lessons and infrastructure status. It does not provide synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow rows.
candidates.reuse_status: The report may support contextual citation; no raw numerical holdout is available from the record.

candidates.title: HRS-Modell free simulation model
candidates.finding: The public page describes a MATLAB/Simulink model validated by the developers with their own measurements. It provides a simulator, not an independently released measured station-to-vehicle trace archive.
candidates.reuse_status: Useful model-comparison lead only; simulator outputs cannot be promoted to a physical external holdout.

next_action: Obtain a de-identified synchronized logger export and written reuse terms from a custodian such as Cal State LA HRFF, NREL/NLR HITRF, CARB/HyStEP, JRC GasTeF, FCH2RAIL or an HRS operator; freeze model, inclusion criteria and scoring before reading numerical outcomes.
claim_boundary: This record documents a search and exclusion decision. It does not add validation evidence, change frozen results or permit a publication-readiness claim.
